screens.name: chats_home
screens.description: The Chats home screen offers new conversations, recent chats, characters, and other app features.

screens.name: luzia_chat
screens.description: A new conversation with Luzia offers a message composer and suggested tasks.

screens.name: chat_attachments_sheet
screens.description: A sheet in the Luzia chat offers photo and file attachments and a Deep reasoning option.

screens.name: luzia_plus_paywall
screens.description: The Luzia+ paywall presents subscription plans, a free-trial offer, and paid benefits.

screens.name: apps_explore
screens.description: The Create Explore page features recommended and trending apps, search, and an option to create an app.

screens.name: create_app
screens.description: The Create screen lets users describe an app idea, record an idea, or start from a creative example.

screens.name: app_draft_detail
screens.description: A generated app draft shows a playable preview, visibility setting, and options to rename, edit, or publish it.

screens.name: edit_app_draft
screens.description: The Edit screen lets users revise an app draft's idea and open its playable preview.

screens.name: color_flood_game
screens.description: A Color Flood puzzle screen where players choose colors to fill the board before running out of moves.

screens.name: app_username_confirmation
screens.description: A sheet asks the user to confirm the name shown on apps they publish.

screens.name: my_apps
screens.description: The My Apps page shows recently used apps and saved, published, and draft apps.

screens.name: app_edit_review
screens.description: The Edit review screen compares an app before and after a proposed change and lets the user save or discard it.
